{"code": "from collections import Counter

# Filter to the TREATMENT arm
treatment_df = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Check the number of patients in the TREATMENT arm
n_treatment = len(treatment_df)
print(f"Number of patients in TREATMENT arm: {n_treatment}")

# Count how many responded (responded == 1)
responded_yes = treatment_df['responded'].sum()
print(f"Number of responders in TREATMENT arm: {responded_yes}")

# Compute the fraction
fraction_responded = responded_yes / n_treatment
print(f"Fraction of patients in TREATMENT arm who responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
